name: Wan2.2 I2V 14B Lightning - Fast Preview
description: Quick Image to Video Generation + Sound (optional)

paragraphs: The default MODELINITMODE=startup prepares FP8 transformers, places the pipeline on emulated CUDA, and attaches the existing AOTI graph before launch. ZeroGPU can then snapshot prepared weights rather than transferring and preparing the full bf16 pipeline inside each GPU allocation. The text encoder stays bf16 to avoid its expensive CPU int8 conversion.

Startup and tensor packing will take longer than the old lazy startup. After a rebuild, wait for the Space to become Running before measuring generation. If startup quantization or packing stalls on the host, set MODELINITMODE=worker in Settings → Variables and secrets and restart. That fallback retains per-allocation preparation and its slower first response; GPUWARMUPALLOWANCE defaults to 240 seconds in that mode only.

Selected LoRAs download before GPU allocation and are explicitly activated. They run through eager FP8 forwards because the base AOTI graph does not include external adapter branches. Requests without LoRAs use AOTI. Adapter errors stop the request, and adapters and forwards are restored even after failures. LORATIMEMULTIPLIER defaults to 1.8 for the duration estimate; this is a safety estimate, not a measured speed guarantee.
